title: Mobile pass: single-column classes, Agenda-first calendar, compact Month cells
summary: Classes: a category set to show 2 or 3 per row (for browsing on a laptop) no longer squeezes cards down to ~150px on a phone. Below 640px wide, every category goes full-width with one class per row, regardless of its desktop perRow setting -- nothing about your actual class data changes, just how it lays out on a narrow screen.

Calendar: a phone landing on the Calendar tab for the first time now starts on Agenda (a scrollable list of days) instead of Month's dense 7-column grid, which was unreadable at that size. If you've already picked a view before, your last choice is remembered as always, on any device.

If you do switch to Month view on a phone, each day cell now shows just the date, the A/B Day badge, and a small row of plain colored dots for whatever's happening that day, instead of trying to cram full event titles into a digit-sized box. Tapping the cell still opens the full day.
